CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its represented organization (coordinate pattern) and origin/status are all explicitly recorded for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing or allocation to the content's organization or access is stated.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit named content variables with color attributes and their coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Each content entry is accompanied by separate origin/provenance metadata, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map onto the grid and presents content as explicit coordinate patterns, i.e. organized representations.
